A mobile battle for the ages as we compare the same games running on Switch 2 in mobile mode up against iPhone 17 Pro. Switch 2 has the advantage of more specific optimisation from developers and active cooling at the expense of form factor and a much less efficient process node. So based on the games available for direct comparison, what have we learned?
